sample_unit: expert evaluations per chatbot (12 specialists x 13 questions)

links.outcome: Specialist-rated quality of chatbot answers to PGT questions, by model and question type
links.effect: ChatGPT simple 16.83±1.80/25, controversial 27.75±4.49/40; Gemini 14.92±2.02, 26.08±3.99; Llama 13.58±3.60, 16.92±4.96. ChatGPT and Gemini outperformed Llama; performance lower for controversial questions.
links.quote: Generative AI shows moderate reliability in addressing PGT-related enquiries, with ChatGPT and Gemini outperforming Llama.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and reliability of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Llama) responding to patient questions about preimplantation genetic testing, scored offline by reproductive medicine specialists.
